text_block_list.text:
When I stopped by the Kansai Local 
Products Fair— I spotted Tamamo Cross and 
Super Creek.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, this stall... Isn't this the 
ikayaki stall you were looking for, 
Tama-chan?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yer right! Way to go, Creek! Hey lady, 
give us some ikayaki!!

text_block_list.name: Stall Lady
text_block_list.text:
Welcome... Come get authentic Osaka-style 
ikayaki. You want two, little miss?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Sure do, but... Why do ya look so down in 
the dumps? What happened?

text_block_list.name: Stall Lady
text_block_list.text:
Sales just haven't been too great. Folks 
around here think ikayaki means 
whole-grilled squid. I don't think they 
know how we do it back in Osaka.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Even though yer workin' so hard to make 
'em... Now I'm gettin' all riled up too—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Alright! I'll go drum up some business for 
ya!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I'll help out too. Let's do 
our best together~.

text_block_list.name: Stall Lady
text_block_list.text:
That'd be a huge help! You girls are the 
sweetest horse girls in the world!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Just leave it all to us and wait 
right here~!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hey! You two over there! Don'tcha wanna 
try some crazy good ikayaki?!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that just whole-grilled squid? You 
can get that anywhere...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no! It's totally different from 
what you're thinkin' of!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It's an Osaka specialty where squid is 
pressed into a crepe! And today it's 
specially priced at 5 million yen a 
pack~!!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Tama-chan, is that true? Was ikayaki an 
ultra-luxurious delicacy all along...?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Are you kiddin' me?! That was a joke!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Though the taste really is worth 5 
million yen! I love ikayaki, so I 
guarantee it!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Tama-chan... You care that much about 
ikayaki... I'm almost getting jealous.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Jealous like grilling squid?! Quit makin' 
puns! Why're you tryin' to compete with 
squid anyway?!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! That's hilarious! Maybe I'll try 
buying some ikayaki!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
For real?! Then go grab some at that food 
stall over there~!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Alright, on to the next one! Hey there, 
lookin' good, mister—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Alright, on to the next one! Hey there, 
lookin' good, miss—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you're a Trainer from the Academy! 
Were you watchin' us this whole time?!
choice_data_list:
I was just thinking you're great at 
advertising.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Business ain't just about crunchin' 
numbers! Communication is super important 
too!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Though, weren't we just having a regular 
chat?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Our heart reached 'em, that's what! Our 
fiery heart wanting to help that lady out!
choice_data_list: Now I want to eat some too.
Now I want to eat some too.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Our heart reached 'em, that's what! Our 
fiery heart wanting to help that lady out!
choice_data_list: Now I want to eat some too.
Now I want to eat some too.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Much obliged! Keep buyin' 'til you drop~!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu♪ Tama-chan, you look like you're 
having so much fun~.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
'Course I am! In business, both the seller 
and the buyer end up happy!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ikayaki makes everybody happy! Nothin' 
beats that, honest~!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You bet! I can already picture the big 
smile on the lady's face~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu~. What a good girl you are, 
Tama-chan~. Here, let me give you some 
pats♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what's with ya all of a sudden?! 
Stop treatin' me like a kid!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
If yer gonna praise me anyway, at least 
save it for when the ikayaki is all sold 
out!
